methods_actually_executed: SDK event 0 Write call-9aa1dae03cad4999862424773da54278 authored build.py; event 1 Bash call-6238bd6252da4e3ba147b8f911b54bc7 ran Blender. Captured code built cube room and tables, parametric chair shells, pedestal and casters, curved hex wall lines, window and lamps, then saved and rendered. Evidence: /evidence/sdk_events.json:1-103; /evidence/executions/blender_1795841552908342099/code/build.py:6-92; /evidence/executions/blender_1795841552908342099/stdout.log:1-5.
student_verification: The student received the Blender tool output confirming saves, but the recorded trace contains no image-read, comparison, revision, diagnostic or further render. Rendering alone is not visual verification. Evidence: /evidence/sdk_events.json:89-138; /evidence/evidence_index.json:116-149.
failures_and_recovery: Deliverables were complete; the one recorded Blender execution returned exit code 0 with no Python traceback and saved scene and render. Material.use_nodes and World.use_nodes deprecation warnings were reported; no recovery was recorded or needed. SDK completed normally, not a bridge failure. Evidence: /app/input_index.json:8-16; /evidence/evidence_index.json:3-35,120-149; /evidence/sdk_events.json:89-118.
side_effects: The build deletes objects from its current Blender scene before constructing its replacement and writes /app/scene.blend and /app/final.png. Geometric wallpaper creates many separate curve objects; evaluator counted 1591 objects. Evidence: /evidence/final_source/build.py:4,27-41,92; /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:2-6.
spatial_and_orientation_analysis: Reference and delivered render both show a centered two-pane window, rows of desks and white wheeled chairs and two lamps at the right. The candidate is much more front-on and distant: furniture is smaller in frame, a larger portion of the room and top boundary is visible, and the reference's large near chairs, edge cropping and oblique convergence are not reproduced. These are image observations, not aligned 3D errors. Evidence: supplied reference and delivered candidate images; /evidence/executions/blender_1795841552908342099/artifacts/final.png; /evidence/final_source/build.py:46-76,89-91.

The student places chair backs on the near side of their seats and tables behind them, consistent with chairs facing work surfaces; reference visibility supports the general relation but not exact swivel angles. Table/chair overlap and perspective confound precise row-to-row instance matching. Evidence: /evidence/final_source/build.py:46-76; supplied images; /evidence/reference_gt/reference_instance_statistics.json:306-464,617-767.

The candidate glass is a surface in front of a solid back wall, not an established opening to a modeled exterior. The right-side cabinet sliver in the reference has no clear counterpart in the generated source. Evidence: /evidence/final_source/build.py:22-25,42-45; /evidence/reference_gt/reference_instance_statistics.json:482-496; supplied images.
appearance_and_resource_analysis: The render captures pale walls, hexagonal pattern, dark desks and white shells, but appears flatter and more muted; reference has stronger warm lamp-wall pools and a larger, darker window frame. Lighting, geometry, view and tone mapping all confound the difference. Evidence: supplied images; /evidence/final_source/build.py:6-8,27-45,77-92.

The window glass mesh uses pale blue window glass, an opaque default Principled material; the saved-state extraction reports an unlinked base-color input, and the script sets color and roughness. The hex pattern is actual curves with fine grey hexagonal joints rather than a mapped image texture. No texture coordinate or directional mapping is used by the authored material function. Evidence: /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/object_inventory.jsonl:1430-1435; /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/detailed_state.json:469174-469220; /evidence/final_source/build.py:6-8,18-21,27-45.

The extracted state has only unpacked Blender viewer images with empty paths and no missing external images; no evidence of a full-reference image plane. A Principled BSDF-to-Material Output link is present in extracted material state. Evidence: /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/detailed_state.json:470250-470290; /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:5-7; /evidence/final_source/build.py:1-92.
geometry_analysis: The chair backs are custom curved meshes with Solidify and Subdivision modifiers, and their seats, five radial rods and caster spheres are separate meshes. Tables have thin tops and legs; lamp shades are cones on stems and feet. These constructions are editable, but the existence of parts does not prove contact or connectivity. Evidence: /evidence/final_source/build.py:46-82.

Independent extraction lists 221 AABB overlap candidates, not confirmed intersections or support errors; no student surface-contact verification is recorded. Evidence: /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:8-11; /evidence/sdk_events.json:1-138.

Source-only regeneration succeeded without the external capability library and independently reproduced a pixel-identical 640x360 image; this is reproducibility evidence, not proof of student verification or scene fidelity. unsupported_or_unknown_claims: No inferred causal library benefit, hidden reasoning, numerical aligned 3D error, or physically verified support/contact. No claim of student visual comparison or iterative improvement is supported by the SDK trace. Evidence: /evidence/sdk_events.json:1-138; /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:8-15.
limitations: Semantic correspondences are automated model proposals, not manually verified or deterministic mask matches. Repeated chairs and desks are deliberately not individually mapped because assembly membership and one-to-one identities were not sufficiently established. Evidence: /evidence/reference_gt/reference_instance_statistics.json:306-464,617-767; /evidence/final_source/build.py:46-76.

Inventory projected bounds are unclipped bounding boxes, not visible-mask centroids, and GT and student transforms do not establish a shared coordinate frame or scale. One image leaves hidden surfaces, exact dimensions and symmetric orientations uncertain.
